target_customer: Independent and enterprise-affiliated financial advisors and wealth management firms who pay for prospecting and marketing software
problem: Advisors spend large amounts of time on business development to win each new client and organic growth is their central problem. FINNY finds and scores prospects and automates outreach.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for advisors and firms
product_category: AI prospecting and marketing platform for financial advisors

founders.name: Eden Ovadia
prior_employers: BCG (Tech, Financial Institutions and Private Equity practices)
education: McGill University, Software Engineering with ML focus

founders.name: Theodore Janson
prior_employers: Early fintech startup (applied ML engineer, unnamed)
education: McGill University, BEng in EE and Math
founders.background_notes: Research roles in LLM explainability and particle physics, per YC page.

founders.name: Victoria Toli
founders.role: Co-founder and CPO (also called President in press)
prior_employers: Uber (Product Manager, Uber One growth and international)

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating prospect data, life-event signals and a per advisor conversion score plus outreach automation is standard applied ML and data engineering with some hard parts around data quality and compliance.

defensibility.rationale: Prospect data and scoring models can compound with usage, but the workflow could be copied by marketing automation vendors and data providers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established advisor marketing vendors announced prospecting products later (a 2025 roundup lists Snappy Kraken launching a prospecting solution alongside FINNY). No incumbent had acquired FINNY as of research.

market_need_then: Financial advisors cite organic growth as their hardest problem, with YC page claiming 60+ hours of business development per new client; advisor technology budgets were growing around AI meeting tools in 2024.

branding.domain_note: Uses finny.com (exact name .com) as of the research date; acquisition history not found

identity.logo: Logo, wordmark and signature element refreshed in a brand identity announcement
identity.visual_style: refreshed identity described as deliberate and modern in press release
identity.voice_and_tone: Clear, advisor-focused, AI-native growth officer framing

branding.brand_signature: Refreshed brand identity launch with new signature (details not captured)

rebrands.why: CEO said the brand had become recognizable and the team wanted to keep core elements while making it more deliberate

branding.community_and_virality: Advisor tech newsletter coverage (Advisor Tech Book 'All in on FINNY') and trade press; no merch or fan content found

brand_strength.rationale: Brand refresh press release and trade press attention show a recognized niche brand, but no mascot or viral assets found.

outcome_analysis: FINNY went from March 2024 founding and a YC Summer 2024 batch to a roughly 4.3M seed in December 2024 and a 17M Series A led by Venrock in December 2025. It focused on a narrow vertical, advisor prospecting, with a clear painful job. Risks are copying by advisor marketing vendors and the dependence on prospect data quality, but funding momentum was strong.
notes: Seed reported as 4.3M by AIM Research and 4.2M by another outlet; recorded 4.3M. Competition list left empty: searches found only 2025 and 2026 dated competitor coverage, nothing dated near the batch; Jump and Zocks are meeting tools rather than prospecting competitors. Series A date from the BusinessWire URL (20251217). Founder page confirms Toli as co-founder and CPO; some press calls her President.
